name: Chronicles of Tal'Dun: The Longing
source:
Most people spend their whole lives never touching the magick, and some are gripped by it before they ever open their eyes. Is there a place in this world for a child cursed with the hunger of the moons? For a song that wants to be sung? Will they devour one another or find salvation in each other’s embrace?

The world of Tal'Dun is shaped by mysterious forces of the Sea, a power that gives and takes life. Touching its waters brings death to most people, but in rare cases some survive it and become magi.  Evin and Near come from very different circumstances,  one grew up in a tiny village and stumbled upon magick by accident, and the other was born with it and spent their life locked away in a temple. Despite this, as if pulled together by the currents of the Sea, their paths cross, and now a storm is brewing.

[From [url=https://nimphradora.itch.io/chronicles-of-taldun-the-longing]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大多数人穷尽一生也从未触碰过魔法，而有些人却在尚未睁眼之时便已被魔法牢牢攫住。对于一个背负着双月饥渴诅咒的孩子、一首渴望被传唱的歌谣而言，这个世界上可有容身之所？他们最终会彼此吞噬，还是在对方的怀抱中觅得救赎？

塔尔敦的世界由神秘的“海”之力量所塑造——这股力量既能赐予生命，亦能夺走生命。触碰海水会给绝大多数人带来死亡，但极少数人能幸存下来并成为魔导师。伊文与尼尔出身截然不同：一个在小村庄里长大，偶然间接触到了魔法；另一个则生来便身怀魔力，一生都被囚禁在神殿之中。即便如此，仿佛受到海中暗流的牵引一般，两人的命运轨迹交汇在了一起，而一场风暴也正悄然酝酿。

[引自[url=https://nimphradora.itch.io/chronicles-of-taldun-the-longing]itch.io[/url]]
